title: Web AI Showcase portfolio acceptance manifest
description: Per-family route-complete acceptance matrix required by scripts/check-portfolio-acceptance.mjs for every NEW or TOUCHED built family since the be427da ratchet. The validator must open every enumerated route at desktop+mobile and name every advertised stage; the run record must prove the latest passing run against the family's current commit.

slug.description: Family slug; must match the catalogue slug.

validator.description: Repo-relative path to the committed real-inference validator (e.g. scripts/validate-<slug>.mjs).

rungs.description: Exactly covers overview + every on-disk route dir containing index.html.

route.description: Repo-relative route dir with trailing slash.

inside.description: Required true on the overview rung: the see-inside surface is exercised there.

stages.description: Every advertised model stage (HF org/id) the family loads; the validator must name each.

runRecord.description: Repo-relative path to the committed latest passing run record (acceptance-run.json).
